description: Share a whole project: chosen chats, Claude Code memory notes, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md and a handoff. First call carry_list_projects with the name and confirm with the user which chats to include (related chats are not included unless added). Write a project-level handoff (goal, architecture, decisions, status, next steps) and pass it. The code itself travels via git.

add.description: Extra chat names to include, e.g. related chats

chats.description: How many of the newest chats started in the project to include (default 5)

project.description: Project name from carry_list_projects, or an absolute folder path

to.description: Paired friends (names): goes into their carry inbox

name: carry_share_project
title: Share a project
